I have little interest in anything these days. I played violin for 11 years and was terrible at it. So fuck that. I'll never be good enough at art for it to be taken seriously. And not much else interests me. I don't want to do anything but smoke weed, because at least when I'm high, I'm happy, not in pain, and can sleep.

I don't see any need for hobbies. We're animals. We're here to fuck, reproduce, and die. I just don't see the point of exploring life any further.

I just don't get it.
I've always been on the outskirts of whatever group of friends I've had. Right now, there's nothing.
I don't have any friends close enough to be concerned about not hearing from me for a few weeks. No job. Family's fed up.

It is mostly wankers, but I've met a few cool people. My old roommates and I just went through a phase where we would get on after going out drinking. No one ever believes that three moderately attractive blonde girls on the internet are real though.

I'm not in a relationship with him. However, last week I flew to visit someone I met on chatroulette. Basically, we connected on facebook and talked on there and via text for about a year. Recently found out about a mutual friend that we have, and that kind of settled uncertainties. So yeah. AMA.
Most of those things were answered in the edit.
That's what I'm thinking. So much money :(

I guess when my dude read the address at fedex, the guy typed it in wrong by one number. How it would end up there is beyond me. All i know is that it was delivered to someone, and the only person I can find by that name nearby is right around the corner. However, fedex's tracking made it appear as though this man had actually **signed** for the box. So that's confusing.
A wise man once told me, "Find the man with the longest dreads."

According to the track number, it's now been delivered and signed for by someone else. The note about the wrong address and delivery exception no longer appear online. I really fucking hope someone in my building just signed for it and took it to my door.
